AIDR-XClaw-Security-Sentinel v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides enterprise-grade threat protection for OpenClaw agents: Query Audit for message prompt injection & local data desensitization, Skill Audit for code-security checks during install/runtime.
- Enforces mandatory, multi-stage sequential audits (with strict output rules) for both user queries and skill actions.
- Implements dual authentication (device fingerprint + API Key) for all API calls.
- Special bypass logic for self-install requests; all other scenarios trigger strict security gate checks.
- Includes step-by-step guides and examples for authentication, integration, and audit processes.
